       self, sql: str, parameters: Sequence[Any] = ()\n    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:\n        \"\"\"Run read-only SQL restricted to declared semantic relation tables.\"\"\"\n\n        statement =           \"SELECT execution_status FROM _tv_derivations WHERE relation_name = ?\",\n            (relation,),\n        ).fetchone()\n        if derivation is None or derivation[\"execution_status\"]
